name: Launchpad
summary: The fullscreen launchpad, built into Droppy
description:
Launchpad puts the old Launchpad back on Droppy’s shelf. Tap the tile and a fullscreen dark-glass sheet opens over whatever you were doing: every installed app on this Mac, on swipeable pages with big icons and a search bar.

Type to filter, Return opens the first match, Escape or a click on the desktop closes, and the trackpad pinch opens and closes it like the original. A no-match query hands off to Siri.
